example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দুর্ঘটনায় নাড়ি ছাড়া হয়ে গেছে।
পুরনো গাছটি নাড়ি ছাড়া হয়ে পড়ে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He died in the accident and became lifeless.
The old tree has withered and become lifeless.
note: This idiom draws from the traditional understanding of pulse as a sign of life in Bengali folk medicine.
